title: Leeuwis2021
description: Single-session EEG dataset of left- versus right-hand motor imagery recorded from 55 novice BCI users with a 16-channel g.Nautilus system at 250 Hz. Each participant completed one calibration run without feedback and three feedback runs. The data were collected to study how psychological and cognitive factors, including personality and visual imagery vividness, predict motor-imagery BCI performance.
methods_description: 16-channel EEG (10-20 montage) recorded at 250 Hz with a g.Nautilus amplifier, referenced to the right earlobe with AFz as ground. Each session had four runs: one calibration run without feedback and three feedback runs of 40 trials each (20 left, 20 right). Trials were cue-based with visual cues and visual feedback, and lasted about 5 s.
